mappingSource: catalog (thrustmaster.json, confidence low: "numbering is not published -> controls without input"); the quick start guide (https://ts.thrustmaster.com/download/accessories/pc/joysticks/manuals/usb_joystick/USB_Joystick_QSG.pdf) lists 1 POV button, 2 four action buttons, 3 sliding thumb throttle, and the product page (https://www.thrustmaster.com/products/usb-joystick/) "3 axis and 4 buttons + 1 trigger"; no numbers, so the markers only say where the control is
note: Two photos are tagged "main" (this 1920x1080 one and the 800x600 support photo); gallery-2 shows the same stick straight from behind. The two "Head button" and the two "Base button" parts are interchangeable in the catalog; assigned left to right by JoyPro only. The two base buttons are the round hex-ringed buttons left and right of the gimbal.
